title: In repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/gap-to-feature.ts, persist the pending-verification verdict that the pick-time
description:
In repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/gap-to-feature.ts, persist the pending-verification verdict that the pick-time check already computes, so the candidate-set exclusion can see it and stop re-picking the same gaps forever.

ANCHOR. This exact line occurs EXACTLY ONCE in the file:
  if (_pickCond === 'pending') {

Immediately inside that block, AFTER the existing console.log line that ends with `PENDING verification at pick time — skipping re-compose\`);` and BEFORE the `return {` that follows it, insert exactly this one statement:

    await markPendingVerification(gap, undefined, "pending at pick time: landed once, no measurement predicate — persisted so the candidate filter can exclude it");

Change nothing else. Do not touch the console.log, the return value, the enclosing condition, the comment above it, the top of the file, or any import.

WHY. `_pickCond` is recomputed by verifyGapCondition on every pick. For a gap that has a landed commit naming it and no measurement predicate, that recomputation returns 'pending' every single time, so the pick is discarded. But this branch writes NOTHING back to the gap store, while the picker's candidate-set exclusion (the `skipped_pending` count in the pick log) filters on the STORED `classification_metadata.disposition`. The result is a closed loop with no exit: the picker ranks the gap top, the pick-time check recomputes 'pending' and discards the cycle, nothing is persisted, the exclusion filter stays blind, and the same gap wins the next tick.

MEASURED IMPACT, twice in a row on a quiet box (loadavg ~3, zero compose-cap refusals, so this is not contention): 25 picks / 25 skipped / 0 composes over 40 minutes, then 13 picks / 13 skipped / 0 composes over 30 minutes. In both windows the picks resolved to just FOUR distinct gap ids — route-edit-040f827e, route-edit-c263f498-narrowed, route-edit-0da646c8, route-edit-7b7e0ea0-narrowed — out of 817 open gaps. All four carry `disposition: None` and no `pending_outcome_verification` in the store, which is exactly the symptom: the pick-time check knows they are pending and the store does not. The compose lane has produced zero executions across both windows.

WHY THIS IS SAFE AND NOT A BEHAVIOUR CHANGE. It does not change what the pick-time check decides, and it does not re-enable composing these gaps — the skip and the returned `pending_verification` report are untouched. It only records the verdict that was already reached, using the same helper the sweep already calls for the identical situation at the `markPendingVerification(g, sha, "pending sweep: single landing, no measurement predicate")` call site. `markPendingVerification` is declared at module scope in this same file and is already awaited at three other call sites, so it is in scope here.
